fusions.name: Parting Shot
fusions.desc: A kick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tossed Aside
fusions.desc: Bounds past a target up to 5 tiles away. It deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at maximum range, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Startled Bound
fusions.desc: Springs you to a spot up to 7 tiles away. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Sprung Gait
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (16% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
